name: ayatori
description: Ayatori query plane for Kotobase -- materialization and query access over content-addressed graph data.
comment: These are not new: the suite already resolved @noble/hashes through kotoba-lang/io-multiformats and only ran because a parent directory of the west checkout happened to have one. An undeclared dependency that resolves by accident is the shape of a green that cannot be reproduced elsewhere, so it is declared. @noble/curves is held at 1.x because kotoba-lang/org-signal's x25519 calls utils.randomPrivateKey, which 2.x renamed. @noble/post-quantum is exact and matches the version kotoba-lang/envelope pins its ML-KEM module digest to; a different one there is refused by envelope.qualify, and silently unqualified here.
